item.title: 澳娛綜合義工團隊中秋送暖 向2600弱勢基層派福包獻關愛
item.description:
>
澳娛綜合開展中秋送暖大行動，惠及約2,600人。 澳娛綜合為迎接中秋佳節，於本月1日至24日開展「澳娛綜合中秋送暖大行動」系列活動，動員近百人次的義工團隊深入全澳多個社福機構及弱勢群體，合共探訪850戶家庭，向約2,600名受惠人士送上福包與節日祝福，傳遞佳節歡欣與社會關愛，切實發揚守望相助的優良傳統。 澳娛綜合秉持「取諸社會、用諸社會」的宗旨，多年來心繫社區，是次探訪對象涵蓋兒童、青少年、特殊需要人士及長者等多元群體。受惠機構包括澳門防止虐待兒童會護兒中心、澳門唐心兒協會、澳門特殊奧運會、澳門九澳聖若瑟學校、澳門聽障人士協進會，以及多戶獨居長者、單親家庭及貧困家庭等，傾聽基層心聲，將企業關懷落實到社區之中。 除了派發福包，義工團隊更積極推動青銀共融。例如與澳門仁慈堂持續合辦「我和我的老友記」長者友誼計劃，9月份特設中秋主題，澳娛綜合義工隊走進仁慈堂安老院與長者一同製作中秋特色手工藝品並進行趣味猜謎，讓長者在歡聲笑語中感受濃厚傳統節慶氛圍。此外，澳娛綜合亦於本月13日攜手澳門明愛的青少年前往伯大尼安老院探訪，帶來精彩的音樂表演與互動遊戲，讓長者在悠揚旋律與歡笑聲中歡度佳節。 澳娛綜合表示，未來將繼續透過各類社區關懷活動踐行企業社會責任，積極關愛社會不同群體，合力建設青銀共融、友愛同行的和諧社區。

item.title: 國慶黃金周受惠盛事帶動 業界料日均訪澳旅客達12萬人次
item.description: https://www.allinmedia.com.hk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/9月25日-黃金周預測.mp4 十一國慶黃金周假期將至，澳門旅遊、餐飲及零售業再度迎來傳統消費旺季。綜合旅遊業界與學術界預測，今年黃金周期間日均訪澳旅客料達12 萬人次。儘管受旅客消費模式轉型影響，人均消費呈放緩趨勢，但龐大的客流與盛事活動疊加，仍將成為拉動澳門全年經濟復甦及完成財政稅收目標的關鍵動力。 澳門旅遊業議會會長胡景光受訪時表示，在各項大型盛事與中央多項惠澳政策的疊加效應下，假期日均客量達12萬人次預期樂觀，全年總訪澳客量更有望衝擊4,300萬至4,400萬人次。胡景光分析，目前旅客消費模式已深度轉向自由行及深度體驗遊，客群仍以家庭及年輕人為主，消費意願依然強勁。在社區經濟方面，雖然澳門政府透過休遊巴士等措施帶動人潮入區，但社區中小企仍需主動轉型，推出如特色茶飲、精品咖啡等差異化產品，才能有效吸引年輕消費族群。 至於市場關注的酒店房價問題，胡景光指近年澳門酒店房間供應量較疫情前增加兩至三成，黃金周期間路氹區酒店房價預計維持在4,000至5,000元，澳門半島則約1,000至2,000元。整體房價趨於平穩理性，擺脫過往「海鮮價」形象，反而能有效降低旅客留宿成本，吸引更多旅客延長在澳門的逗留時間。 澳門理工大學博彩旅遊教學及研究中心教授曾忠祿分析，預期今個黃金周訪澳總旅客量將超過去年同期的350萬人次，料達370萬人次或更高。然而受限於旅客人均消費下降，預計10月份博彩毛收入約落在230億至240億澳門元之間，與去年同期基本持平或略有下調。 曾忠祿補充指雖然博彩收入增幅放緩，但順利完成政府全年預算目標並無懸念。澳門政府今年博彩毛收入預算目標為2,360億澳門元，截至目前已完成逾七成，後續財政壓力相對有限。 針對近年來「高客量、低消費」的結構性現象，曾忠祿強調，這反映出澳門客源結構正歷經深層次轉型。疫情以來，過往的豪賭客大幅減少，取而代之是家庭客以及55歲以上的年長客群(佔整體客量約28%)。這類客群消費模式相對理性，雖令賭收爆炸性增長不再，但也大幅降低問題賭博的風險，反而令澳門整體經濟與博彩業發展更具韌性、更趨健康及可持續。 隨着口岸疏導機制、旅遊巴士調配及各項非博彩盛事活動陸續到位，澳門旅遊及博彩業界已全面就位。今年國慶黃金周不僅是檢驗澳門旅遊承載力與服務質素的「試金石」，更是觀察澳門「1+4」經濟適度多元化進程的重要指標。業界普遍期望，在濃厚的節慶氣氛加持下，黃金周的高峰客流能進一步滲透社區，實現綜合旅遊休閒企業與社區中小企的雙贏發展，為澳門經濟持續回升向好注入強勁動能。

item.title: Macau’s Daily Visitor Arrivals Expected to hit 120,000 during Golden Week
item.description:
>
With the October National Day Golden Week holiday approaching, Macau’s tourism, dining, and retail sectors are once again welcoming a traditional peak consumption season. Combining forecasts from the tourism industry and academia, the daily average number of visitor arrivals to Macau during this year’s Golden Week is expected to reach 120,000.   The massive influx of visitors combined with major events will remain a key driving force to stimulate Macau’s annual economic recovery and achieve its fiscal tax revenue targets.   In an interview, Andy Wu, President of the Travel Industry Council of Macau, stated that under the synergistic effects of various major events and multiple favorable policies introduced by the central government, the expectation of a daily average of 120,000 visitors during the holiday is optimistic. Total annual visitor arrivals to Macau are even expected to challenge 43 million to 44 million. Wu analyzed that visitor consumption patterns have deeply shifted toward independent travel and immersive experiences, with the demographic remaining primarily families and young people whose willingness to spend remains robust. Regarding the community economy, although the government is driving visitor traffic into local neighborhoods through measures such as tour shuttle buses, community SMEs still need to proactively transform by introducing differentiated products such as specialty tea drinks and boutique coffee to effectively attract young consumer groups.   Regarding the market’s focus on hotel room rates, Wu pointed out that Macau’s hotel room supply has increased by 20% to 30% compared to pre-pandemic levels. During Golden Week, hotel room rates in the Cotai area are expected to remain between MOP 4,000 and MOP 5,000, while those on the Macau Peninsula will be around MOP 1,000 to MOP 2,000. Overall room rates are tending to be stable and rational, moving away from the past image of fluctuating “catch-as-catch-can” pricing, which instead effectively lowers overnight costs for travelers and encourages them to extend their stay in Macau.   Zeng Zhonglu, President of Asia Pacific Association for Gambling Studies (APAGS), analyzed that the total number of visitor arrivals to Macau this Golden Week is expected to exceed the 3.5 million from the same period last year, reaching 3.7 million or higher. However, constrained by a decline in per capita spending, gross gaming revenue for October is projected to land between MOP 23 billion and MOP 24 billion, remaining largely flat compared to the same period last year or showing a slight adjustment downward.   Zeng added that although the growth rate of gaming revenue has slowed, successfully meeting the government’s annual budget target is beyond doubt. The SAR government’s gross gaming revenue budget target for this year is MOP 236 billion, and over 70% of it has already been achieved to date, leaving subsequent fiscal pressure relatively limited.   Addressing the structural phenomenon of high visitor volume and low spending in recent years, Zeng emphasized that this reflects a profound transformation in Macau’s source market structure. Since the pandemic, traditional high-rollers have decreased significantly, replaced by family travelers and older demographics aged 55 and above (accounting for about 28% of total visitors). While this consumer group’s spending pattern is relatively rational, meaning explosive growth in gaming revenue is a thing of the past, it also substantially lowers the risk of problem gambling, making Macau’s overall economic and gaming industry development more resilient, healthier, and sustainable.   This year’s National Day Golden Week is not only a touchstone for testing Macau’s tourism carrying capacity and service quality, but also an important indicator for observing the progress of Macau’s 1+4 adequate economic diversification. The industry generally expects that, enhanced by a strong festive atmosphere, the peak visitor traffic during Golden Week will further penetrate local communities, achieving a win-win development for integrated tourism and leisure enterprises alongside community SMEs, and injecting strong momentum into Macau’s continuous economic recovery and upward trend.

item.title: 治安警揭氹仔桑拿場操縱賣淫拘4負責人 20按摩女認提供性服務
item.description:
>
澳門治安警搗破桑拿賣淫案，帶走45人返署調查。 為配合國慶與中秋佳節前的治安淨化工作，澳門治安警察局近日持續加強打擊非法工作及賣淫等違規行為。在本周三(23日)的聯合巡查行動中，治安警聯同澳門勞工局成功揭發氹仔區一間桑拿場所有人涉及非法工作及操縱賣淫，帶走4名本地負責人及41名報稱從事按摩與清潔工作的女子返警局協助調查。 被帶走的41名女子中，經核實共有38人涉嫌違規工作，年齡介乎20至50歲。該群違規勞工背景複雜，包括27名黑工及11名家傭、按摩員和侍應等過界工作者，國籍涵蓋泰國、坦桑尼亞、南韓、俄羅斯、越南、緬甸、印尼及內地等地。其中有20人已在盤問中承認曾於場所內提供性服務，執法人員亦在現場檢獲一批安全套及潤滑劑等懷疑與賣淫相關的證物。 警方初步調查顯示，桑拿場所自今年5月份開始運作至今，對外收費大約介乎2,500至6,000澳門元不等。面對警方的調查，4名涉案負責人採取不合作的態度。目前，警方已將涉嫌操縱賣淫的刑事部分正式立案並移送檢察院偵辦，至於違反勞動關係法的過界及黑工部分則移交澳門勞工事務局跟進。

item.title: 粵澳聯破賣淫集團拘77人 揭設招嫖群組聘分單手路氹拉客
item.description:
>
粵澳警方聯手搗破跨境賣淫集團共拘77人。(司警局圖片) 澳門司警聯同廣東省公安廳，於本周三(23日)同步開展代號「季風行動」的聯合打擊行動，搗破一個跨境操縱賣淫犯罪集團，合共拘捕77名涉案人士。 澳門司警於今年7月接獲線報，發現有犯罪集團於網上設立招嫖群組，招攬女子赴澳門從事賣淫，隨即透過警務聯絡機制通報內地公安，並聯同廣東省公安廳成立專案小組展開聯合偵查。 經調查，涉案主腦為39歲內地姓易無業女子。易女在內地建立通訊群組，物色有意赴澳賣淫的女子，藉收取每人每7日200元人民幣的「入群費」牟利；集團同時在澳門招攬多名「飛單手」，於路氹多間酒店外拉客，再由易女調派賣淫女子，供嫖客挑選及於酒店房內提供性服務。 集團統一設定收費，每次性交易肉金為1,000至2,500港元，並為賣淫女子設立服務底價；超出底價的金額，「飛單手」可抽取當中88%作報酬。涉案14名「飛單手」年齡介乎24至45歲，均為以旅客身份入境的內地及香港居民。另外，37歲尼泊爾籍男外僱KUNWAR為酒店保安，涉嫌收受報酬，向集團洩露酒店資訊及警方巡查消息，協助集團避開追查。 犯罪集團具一定反偵查手段，主腦要求成員及賣淫女子定期刪除通訊紀錄；一旦有成員發現警車或警方巡查，便會在群組內即時通報。警方估計集團由今年3月起運作，涉案金額約530萬港元，被搗破時群組成員約300人。 行動當日，司警調派110名警員，在路氹區多間酒店外截獲16名集團成員，另於氹仔拘捕11名20至40歲的賣淫女子及4名嫖客；內地警方則於珠海、廣州、深圳、佛山及中山多地，拘捕31名集團成員及15名曾赴澳賣淫的女子，當中包括負責管理群組的39歲澳門籍骨幹姓饒女子。 行動中，司警檢獲情趣內衣、安全套、多部手提電話，以及45,000港元和2,000元人民幣現金。警方已以犯罪集團罪及操縱賣淫罪，將16名集團成員落案，移交檢察院跟進，案件調查仍持續進行。

item.title: 永利臻典夢幻超跑展揭幕 逾20輛殿堂級超跑任打卡
item.description:
https://www.allinmedia.com.hk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/2026-永利超跑.mp4 在澳門旅遊局及澳門體育局的鼎力支持下，「2026永利臻典夢幻超跑展」由本周三(23日)起至11月22日，在永利澳門及永利皇宮同步呈獻，法拉利、保時捷、林寶堅尼、Pagani及Aston Martin等殿堂級汽車品牌，超過20部傳奇超跑齊聚一堂，以典藏視角串連1960年代至今的傳奇巨作，呈獻一場跨越一甲子的汽車工藝盛宴。展覽期間適逢澳門格蘭披治大賽車開跑，兩大盛事一同點燃競速熱情。 Pagani Huayra R x BAPE 「2026永利臻典夢幻超跑展」開幕典禮於本周三在永利皇宮盛大舉行，澳門旅遊局代局長程衛東，澳門體育局特別計劃處處長何兆堃，永利澳門總裁、董事會副主席兼執行董事陳志玲、營運總裁兼執行董事羅偉信、財務總裁錢璟浩、綜合度假村市場策略營銷總裁鄒文瑜等出席活動，共同見證這場國際跑車愛好者翹首以盼的年度盛事揭開帷幕。 保時捷 935(左)及保時捷 Carrera GT(右) 陳志玲於開幕儀式上表示，澳門擁有70多年歷史的格蘭披治大賽車文化，深厚的賽車傳統已成為這座城市獨特的文化名片。永利連續多年舉辦「永利臻典夢幻超跑展」，正是希望發揮澳門的城市優勢，將頂尖汽車工藝、高端生活品味與綜合旅遊體驗相結合，為旅客呈獻更具特色的世界級體驗。2026年是永利深耕澳門20周年，而丙午火馬所代表的創新、突破與持續向前精神，與永利20年來的發展理念高度契合。展望未來，永利將繼續透過「旅遊+」的形式，不斷拓展綜合旅遊休閒體驗的內涵，展現澳門作為「世界旅遊休閒中心」的多元魅力。 邁入第四屆的超跑展以典藏視角重新定義展覽維度，展出的每一輛超跑均是各品牌不同時代的重要代表，串連起頂尖汽車工藝大半個世紀以來的演進軌跡。其中，法拉利三代旗艦巨作於永利皇宮同場集結，包括創辦人Enzo Ferrari生前親自拍板的最後一款車型F40；將一級方程式賽車技術直接注入公路車款的F50；以及開創品牌油電混合動力新紀元的旗艦LaFerrari。 同時，保時捷四款跨世代代表作於永利澳門同場輝映，勾勒出品牌數十年的工程進化軌迹，包括1980年率先將電控四驅、雙渦輪及可調懸掛帶入公路的959；搭載賽道衍生V10引擎與純手動變速箱，被譽為純粹機械駕馭時代的終極經典Carrera GT；全球僅77部且向傳奇賽車「Moby Dick」致敬的935；以及自然進氣引擎巔峰之作911 GT3 RS 4.0。 今年展覽更迎來時尚與賽車工藝的強強聯手──BAPE × Pagani Huayra R聯乘超跑首度登場。為慶祝BAPE STORE MACAU專門店正式進駐永利皇宮，永利特別呈獻這款全球限量30部的純賽道超跑，展出車款披上BAPE澳門限定迷彩塗裝，將意大利超跑工藝與鮮明的街頭美學巧妙融合。 「2026永利臻典夢幻超跑展」免費向公眾開放，展期內永利亦將陸續揭曉更多稀世典藏車款。作為永利專屬高端生活方式品牌，「Wynn Signature永利臻典」匯聚世界珍饈美饌、頂級度假體驗、全球名品享受以及瑰麗多彩的高端主題盛會，旨在為賓客締造「只此一刻，盡在永利」的稀世尊貴。 「2026永利臻典夢幻超跑展」現正展出的超跑陣容如下：
法拉利 F40 法拉利 F50 法拉利 LaFerrari 法拉利 812 Competizione Aperta 法拉利 SF90 XX Stradale 法拉利 Dino 246 GT 法拉利 488 Pista 法拉利 F8 Tributo 保時捷 935 保時捷 959 保時捷 Carrera GT 保時捷 911 GT3 RS 4.0 林寶堅尼 Miura 林寶堅尼 Centenario Roadster 林寶堅尼 Countach 林寶堅尼 Murciélago LP640 林寶堅尼 Huracán STO Pagani Huayra Oro Giallo Pagani Huayra R BAPE® 特別版 Pagani Zonda F Absolute Aston Martin Valhalla

item.title: Singapore Tightens Anti-Money Laundering Rules and enforces mandatory patron information sharing
item.description:
>
Singapore Tightens Anti-Money Laundering Rules and enforces mandatory patron information sharing Singapore has implemented a second tranche of amendments to its casino laws, introducing new measures covering financial crimes, casino offences and vulnerable patrons. Under the amendments, which took effect on 21 September, licensed casino operators in the city-state may directly share patron risk information to combat money laundering, terrorism financing, and financing linked to proliferation of weapons of mass destruction. Prior to the new law, restrictions under personal data protection legislation meant casinos could not exchange information on high-risk patrons directly with one another. Risk records had to be relayed through the Authority as an intermediary, resulting in cumbersome procedures and slower risk response. Under the new rules, the Gambling Regulatory Authority (GRA) may issue written directions requiring licensed casinos to exchange patron risk information directly, supported by an electronic information-sharing system. Casino operators are required to notify other licensees of a patron’s risk information when they file a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) concerning that patron, or decide to decline services to the individual. Existing contractual or confidentiality clauses between casinos do not override compliance with GRA’s information-sharing directions, and non-compliance attracts penalties. Singapore currently has only two licensed casinos: Marina Bay Sands and Resorts World Sentosa. The new regime applies to both operators. GRA will conduct ongoing inspections to oversee implementation and monitor information exchange workflows, to safeguard against misuse of personal data.

item.title: Morpheus becomes Macau’s first Michelin Key 3-star hotel
item.description:
>
Morpheus becomes Macau’s first Michelin Key 3-star hotelMorpheus becomes Macau’s first Michelin Key 3-star hotel Morpheus at City of Dreams, under Melco Resorts & Entertainment, received exciting news yesterday (23rd). In the Michelin Guide Global Hotel Awards 2026, it was elevated from 2 Michelin Keys to the highest tier, winning the prestigious Michelin Key 3-star distinction and becoming Macau’s first ultra-luxury hotel to receive this top global honour in hospitality. The Michelin Key rating system sets “an exceptional stay experience” as its highest benchmark. Among the 2,832 hotels selected worldwide for the 2026 edition, only 155 were awarded 3 Michelin Keys. Morpheus is also one of just two hotels in Hong Kong and Macau to earn this accolade. The Michelin Guide praised Morpheus for seamlessly blending “futuristic architectural design” with ultra-luxury accommodation, fine dining and bespoke personalised service. Mr. Lawrence Ho, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Melco Resorts & Entertainment, remarked that Morpheus was conceived with the vision of creating a hotel unlike any previously seen in Macau. This honour is attributed to the entire team’s commitment to service excellence, culinary artistry and design quality. He expressed pride in bringing Macau its first Michelin Key 3-star recognition. Designed by the late Dame Zaha Hadid, Morpheus is the world’s first skyscraper built with a free-form exoskeleton structure. It was honoured with the UNESCO Versailles Award and named among the “World’s Most Beautiful Hotels”. This latest highest recognition from the Michelin Guide not only showcases its unique appeal combining luxury accommodation, Michelin-starred dining and immersive art, but also raises the international benchmark for luxury hospitality in Macau once again.

item.title: Over 20 Legendary Hypercars Available for Public Viewing at Wynn Signature – 2026 Hypercar Exhibition
item.description:
>
Over 20 Legendary Hypercars Available for Public Viewing at Wynn Signature – 2026 Hypercar Exhibition With the generous support of the Macao Government Tourism Office and the Sports Bureau of the Macao SAR Government, the “Wynn Signature – 2026 Hypercar Exhibition” is being held concurrently at Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace from September 23 through November 22. More than 20 legendary hypercars from iconic automotive marques including Ferrari, Porsche, Lamborghini, Pagani and Aston‑Martin have been assembled for the event. This carefully curated display retraces the evolution of iconic masterpieces dating back to the 1960s, delivering a feast of automotive craftsmanship spanning six decades. Coinciding with the Macau Grand Prix season, the dual spectacles ignite the city’s passion for motorsport. The opening ceremony of the “Wynn Signature – 2026 Hypercar Exhibition” took place at Wynn Palace on September 23. Speaking at the opening ceremony, Ms. Linda Chen, President, Vice Chairman and Executive Director of Wynn Macau, Limited, remarked that Macao boasts a proud motorsport legacy embodied by the Macau Grand Prix. This tradition spanning more than 70 years has evolved into the city’s distinct cultural signature. By hosting the Wynn Signature Hypercar Exhibition year after year, Wynn seeks to leverage Macao’s unique strengths, blending cutting‑edge automotive craftsmanship, premium‑lifestyle experiences and integrated tourism to deliver unparalleled world‑class offerings for visitors. The year 2026 marks the 20th Anniversary of Wynn’s established presence in Macao. The spirit of the “Fire Horse”, symbolising innovation, bold breakthroughs and unstoppable energy, aligns closely with Wynn’s core development philosophy cultivated over the past two decades. Looking ahead, Wynn will continue to bring diverse, world‑class experiences to Macao, expand the possibilities for integrated leisure travel under the “Tourism+” framework, and showcase Macao’s vibrant and multifaceted appeal as a World Center of Tourism and Leisure. Now in its fourth edition, the Hypercar Exhibition redefines the show through elite curation. Every exhibited vehicle represents a defining benchmark from its era, charting decades of pinnacle automotive engineering progress. Three generations of Ferrari’s ultimate flagship masterpieces converge at Wynn Palace, illustrating the marque’s evolutionary journey: the F40, the final masterpiece personally approved by founder Enzo Ferrari; the F50, limited to 349 units worldwide, which brings Formula 1 technology directly to road‑going vehicles; and LaFerrari, limited to 499 units globally, the trailblazing flagship that ushered in the brand’s new hybrid‑performance era. Over at Wynn Macau, four era‑defining Porsche icons take centre‑stage, chronicling the brand’s engineering advancement. These include the 959, which brought electronically controlled all‑wheel drive, twin‑turbocharging and adjustable suspension to public roads and embodied pioneering 1980s technology; the Carrera GT with its race‑bred V10 engine and pure manual transmission, revered as the definitive icon of the analog supercar age; the 935, track‑only and produced in a limited run of merely 77 units as a tribute to the legendary “Moby Dick” race car; and the 911 GT3 RS 4.0, the absolute pinnacle of naturally aspirated power, much sought‑after by elite collectors worldwide. This year’s show features an exciting powerful crossover between fashion and automotive engineering: the debut of the BAPE® × Pagani Huayra R hypercar. Created to mark the launch of BAPE STORE® MACAU at Wynn Palace, this track‑only Pagani Huayra R sports the exclusive one‑of‑a‑kind BAPE STORE® MACAU CAMO livery. While the Huayra R itself has a global production cap of just 30 examples, this special exhibit fuses Italian hypercar craftsmanship with bold street‑culture aesthetics. Admission to the “Wynn Signature – 2026 Hypercar Exhibition” is complimentary for the public. Additional ultra‑rare hypercar specimens will be unveiled successively throughout the show period. As Wynn’s exclusive lifestyle brand, Wynn Signature brings together exceptional gastronomy, premium resort experiences, world‑renowned luxury goods and spectacular high‑profile signature events, committed to delivering precious and distinguished moments “only at Wynn” for guests.   Current Hypercar Line‑up for “Wynn Signature – 2026 Hypercar Exhibition” Ferrari F40 Ferrari F50 Ferrari LaFerrari Ferrari 812 Competizione Aperta Ferrari SF90 XX Stradale Ferrari Dino 246 GT Ferrari 488 Pista Ferrari F8 Tributo Porsche 935 Porsche 959 Porsche Carrera GT Porsche 911 GT3 RS 4.0 Lamborghini Miura Lamborghini Centenario Roadster Lamborghini Countach Lamborghini Murciélago LP640 Lamborghini Huracán STO Pagani Huayra Oro Giallo Pagani Huayra R × BAPE® Pagani Zonda F Absolute Aston Martin Valha

item.title: 摩珀斯成澳門首家米芝蓮三星鑰酒店 全球僅155酒店獲此殊榮
item.description:
>
摩珀斯成為澳門首家米芝蓮三星鑰酒店，為港澳地區唯二獲此殊榮的酒店。 新濠博亞娛樂旗下位於新濠天地的摩珀斯酒店(Morpheus)本周三(23日)傳出捷報，於《米芝蓮指南》2026年全球酒店評選中，由去年的兩星鑰晉升至最高級別，榮獲「米芝蓮三星鑰」殊榮，成為澳門首家獲此全球酒店業最高榮譽的頂級奢華酒店。 米芝蓮星鑰評選體系以「非凡的住宿體驗」為最高標準。在2026年度全球獲選的2,832家酒店中，僅有155家摘下三星鑰，而摩珀斯更是港澳地區唯二獲此殊榮的酒店之一，與香港瑰麗酒店(Rosewood Hong Kong)同享殊榮。《米芝蓮指南》特別盛讚摩珀斯將「充滿未來感的建築設計」與頂級奢華住宿、精緻美饌及極致個人化服務完美融合。 新濠主席兼行政總裁何猷龍表示，摩珀斯創立之初即以打造澳門前所未有的酒店為願景，此項榮譽歸功於全體團隊對卓越服務、餐飲美學與設計品質的堅持，很榮幸能為澳門摘下首個米芝蓮三星鑰。 由已故建築大師扎哈‧哈蒂(Dame Zaha Hadid)傾力打造，摩珀斯身為全球首幢自由形態外骨骼結構摩天大樓，曾獲聯合國教科文組織「凡爾賽獎」譽為「全球最美酒店」之一。此次再獲《米芝蓮指南》最高肯定，不僅展現其集奢華住宿、星級餐飲與沉浸式藝術於一身的獨特魅力，更再次刷新澳門奢華款待服務的國際標桿。

item.title: 新加坡強化反洗錢反恐融資監管 賭場准互通高風險賭客資訊
item.description:
>
新加坡強化反洗錢及反恐融資監管。(新加坡旅遊局圖片) 新加坡賭場監管新規本月21日生效，當地持牌賭場營運商可按監管指令，直接共用賭客風險資訊，藉此打擊洗黑錢、恐怖主義融資及大規模殺傷性武器擴散融資活動。 新加坡賭博管制局(GRA)落實《賭場管制(修正)法令2024》相關條文。在新法實施前，受個人資料保護法規所限，賭場如發現高風險客戶，不能直接向其他賭場交換相關資料，有關風險紀錄須經由管制局中轉傳遞，程式繁複，延緩風險應對效率。 根據新規定，管制局可發出書面指示，要求持牌賭場之間直接互通客戶風險資料，並設立電子資訊共用系統處理相關資料。有關客戶資料僅限用於反洗錢、反恐融資及反擴散融資，不得作商業用途，亦不可隨意外洩，只有在法律或法庭命令要求下才可對外披露。 當賭場就客戶提交可疑交易報告，或決定拒絕向有關客戶提供服務時，便須按規定將該客戶的風險資訊，通報其他賭場營運商。即使賭場之間原有合約或保密條款存在限制，亦須遵從管制局的資訊共用指令，違者會面臨懲處。 新加坡現時僅有兩家合法賭場，分別為濱海灣金沙及聖淘沙名勝世界，是次新規適用於該兩間持牌賭場。賭博管制局會持續巡查賭場的執行情況，監察資料交換流程，保障個人資料不被濫用。
